system.summary: One-part numerical French nomenclator, values 10-560, with homophonic letters, endings, syllables, words, names, places, and nulls.
system.notes: R852/R912/R922: key DECODE R639 headed De Monsieur de Bonac et Graffei. R483 uses a different, unrebuilt Latin key (values to ~800).

prior_solution.where: contemporary interlinear decipherments on the leaves (DECODE status Partially decrypted / Non-decrypted)

conditions.human_role: Posed the target from the catalogue; supplied the DECODE session.

solution.what: Fetched the four DECODE text transcriptions (D2172, D2171, D2230, D1861).
Applied DECODE R639 (Bonac et Graffei key, already used for R902 in rakoczi1707) to R922.
Applied R639 to R852 and R912; both read as French reports to Rakoczi.
Applied R639 to the Latin R483: nonsense, so a different key.
R483 found fully deciphered interlinearly at the time (Lwow, 27 June 1711, siege of Munkacs); key not rebuilt.
Direction reversed for R852/R912/R922: Rakoczi is the recipient; R852 names Groffey in the third person.

outcome.notes: Three French letters read in substance from noisy DECODE transcripts; R483 read at the time, its key not rebuilt. Grades count R639-resolved groups over the three French letters.
